results.note: The package adopted 4 Nov says that, subject to Member States' agreement, Montenegro could provisionally close the remaining chapters by the end of this year, and Kos said talks could realistically finish this year while MEP Waitz read the Commission plan as foreseeing the end of talks in December 2026 (both Vijesti); the PDFs could not be read, so this rests on the Commission text as quoted by EWB, and 'could close by end of this year' was read as the Commission's own indicative assessment of a date in 2026.
The Commission's work programme 2027 page, published 4 Nov 2026, lists the Commission work programme document dated 4 November 2026.

Eurostat's flash estimate of 4 Nov gives 4.0% for October, above September's 3.8%.

ČTK's dossier on the dispute, read through 4 Nov evening, and a search show the 3 Nov strike ending with no further dated strike by the organisers or unions; iROZHLAS not readable.

No report found of E.ON, innogy or PRE stating 1 January 2027 open-ended household prices or an explicit unchanged on 3-4 Nov; the comparison updated 4 Nov names only ČEZ for January. Company sites were only partly checkable (innogy refused the request, PRE press and price-list URLs redirected to its home page, E.ON page showed nothing), so this rests on the absence of any report.

AP refused reading; a quoted read of AP's live blog puts its 'Democrats win the US House' entry between AP race calls timed 1:23 and 1:31 a.m. EST on 4 Nov, and AP-bylined copy on PBS on 5 Nov confirms Democrats took Congress, so the call was inside the window.

AP refused reading; the same read of AP's live blog at 11:54 p.m. ET on 3 Nov already had the Senate call (Variety had no AP call just before), and AP-bylined copy on PBS confirms Democratic control of Congress.

The only strike found is Qeshm Island on Monday night 2 Nov, which Trump confirmed on Fox and called early Tuesday; that precedes 08:30 Tehran on 3 Nov, read as outside the window, and no later strike is reported through 4 Nov, Trump saying no immediate plans.
Iran's Rezaei called the US reply unconvincing on 3 Nov and Qatar and Pakistan were still pushing a narrower interim deal on 4-5 Nov; no government said an arrangement had been reached.
EDGAR's latest registration filing is the S-1/A accepted 2 Nov, before the window and with a blank price range; nothing filed 3-4 Nov.
